Results.ReviewText: I was intimidated by charcoal, I had no experience controlling fire. Let me tell you for the first 6 cooks I noted everything I was doing and was very frustrated. I had trouble keeping temps down as you can also use this for low and slow cooking. After a few cooks gunk builds up and the grill begins to season. My kettle is at a point where there is absolutely no leaks. It's a tight snug fit. I smoked a pork but for 13 hours without making vent adjustments. Once you understand your grill it's truly "set it and forget it". I bought this grill because I wasn't happy with my gas grill. The food tasted like chemicals sometimes. I also wasn't happy with my pellet smoker or electric smoker. After having food off of this grill I sold all of my cookers and replaced them with Weber charcoal grills. I now own a Summit Charcoal, 22.5 Weber Smokey Mountains and a new 26" Kettle. I will not go back to any other method of cooking. Charcoal and wood chunks make food taste amazing. I also do not buy BBQ at any restaurant. I highly recommend this grill, just be patient and learn it. It will pay off big time!
Results.Title: Best bang for the buck!

Results.ReviewText: From the lid bale to the large wheels, everything about this grill is amazing!
Results.Title: Great all around grill

Results.ReviewText: 25 + years of using only barrel-type charcoal grill/smokers and i am hooked. the grill assembled in minutes. It is easy to maintain the desired temperature for grilling meat or smoking Alabama chicken. The capacity is deceiving, was able to fit 2 large family packs of chicken thighs on the grill setup for indirect heat.
Results.Title: Very Pleased!

Results.ReviewText: Long time griller/smoker-first time charcoal buyer.  I wanted to expand my grilling options beyond gas, so I decided to buy a charcoal grill.  Weber was my first choice due to their  quality, as I have owned a Weber gasser for years.  The Master Touch is easy to assemble and just as easy to use.  Being a newbie to charcoal, I followed the directions and had the grill fired up to over 500 degrees in no time.  I broke it in with a couple of steaks.  They seared nicely and had much better flavor than what we usually get on our gasser.  The Master Touch design makes clean up simple and easy.  The only knocks I can give this grill are the legs do seem a little wobbly and the old-school bimetal thermometer isn't accurate enough for reliability.  Overall the Master Touch appears to be another high quality Weber grill.
Results.Title: Love my Weber Master Touch

Photos.Caption: My grills. Lots of Weber products in this picture.

Results.ReviewText: Recently I needed an extra grill to cook up some food for a large group so I ran out to buy one. I shopped around before I decided on a new Weber master touch grill. I like the grill’s new features. That’s why I bought it. I don’t like the two piece grate though. It’s a bit of a pain to clean. I do like the ash catcher underneath. It’s a way better design than the old style. The thermometer in the hood is a plus. It gives you a good reference of how hot your coals are inside at least. My biggest gripe with the Weber kettle grills is that the hoods aren’t hinged. The hoop rail thingie they’ve added helps but it’s not a final solution. The hood needs to be hinged. Many times I considered trashing my old Weber for that one and only reason. Overall I’m happy with my newest Weber grill. It cooks hotter than my old Weber. I have no idea why but it does seem to and it’s taller. I might even benefit from a few more inches in height still but it’s at least better than the old. I hate hunching over to check my food.
Results.Title: Great upgrade for the kettle grill.

Results.ReviewText:
It's been decades since I grilled using charcoal. I've got a Weber Genesis gas grill and a large smoker so I thought I had my bases covered. Wrong. What a great addition to my outdoor cooking options. The Master Touch is a great size for most of your grilling needs.  Extremely well constructed, the included accessories and options are really nice. Warming rack, the ability to add charcoal to the grill without having to remove the grilling grate, venting options on both the lid as well as the charcoal bowl, the ash bucket, being able to add other cooking options on the grate and other items.  This is a really terrific charcoal grill.  I've used it some but not as much as you like (weather issues) and everything that I've cooked has been outstanding.  When I decided to get this grill, my wife looked at me like I was nuts. After the first meal, jerk pork tenderloin and grilled sweet potatoes, she became an immediate fan.
This is just a fabulous piece of cooking equipment that you should not deny yourself. I should add that I got a bag of Weber charcoal when I purchased my grill and man, that stuff last forever.
There's simply not enough good things to say about this grill.  Thanks Weber for continuing a long tradition of outdoor enjoyment.

If you are looking for someone to test your products, please do not hesitate to choose me.

Thank you to whoever reads this!
Ben

Results.ReviewText: This was a Christmas gift to me from my family. Its been years since I've owned a grill. I mostly bbq on a large smoker which is great if you're cooking in large quantities. So after researching various styles and brands, the one that stuck out the most was Weber.Weber has one of the largest and most loyal communities I came across. One of the things that impressed me the most was how long these grills were lasting, some in excess of 20 years! That spoke volumes to me. So, Christmas morning 2017, I got what I asked for the Weber  Master-Touch Charcoal Grill 22". I chose this because of the features . The grate allows me to insert accessories from the Weber BBQ Gourmet system. The grate is hinged on both sides to easily add charcoal or wood chunks during a cook. The ash catcher and one touch make clean-up a breeze, and the tuck away lid holder keeps the lid secure while I'm checking the food or fire. This grill holds temperature for hours before having to add any fuel. I love the charcoal baskets, they keep the fuel off the sides, and keep you from using more than you need. A full weber chimney will fill both baskets up perfectly.  I've added some pics of my favorite grill sessions. It was my first time doing a bone-in pork roast and the Weber made it easy and so enjoyable. If your contemplating buying a Weber, my advice is buy it! you won't be disappointed.

Results.ReviewText: I've had this grill for a year, and have cooked on Weber for over 20 years both in the USA and over in the UK. The only thing I'm not a fan about is the new grill grate that Weber has with the removable center ring. Every time you remove the grate to fill with charcoal, you have to be careful that the center ring does not fall out. When I first received my grill, the grate was severely bent and warped. However, Weber's customer service team was very very good and delivered me a new grate in the mail overnight. This is why Weber is by far the best charcoal grill on top of their high quality ceramic coating, sturdiness of the frame, and the composition of metal used for the grates. The Weber Master Touch will last a lifetime and is worth every penny.

The grill also comes with 2 Weber charcoal baskets which I use all the time and enjoy very much. I fully expect this grill to outlast me (I'm approaching retirement) as Weber has proven itself to be a quality producing company and the standard by which all other grills are measured. I would certainly recommend this grill to anyone looking to purchase a charcoal grill.

14501001.Name: 22” Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill
14501001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill. This grill features a handy Tuck-Away Lid Holder that gives you a convenient place to nest the lid against the side of the bowl, a hinged cooking grate that fits circular GBS accessories so you can explore more ways to cook, a built-in lid thermometer, and legs that are 2” taller than standard kettles. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retain heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate fits circular GBS grillware· Included Char-Rails make it easy to arrange charcoal· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Tuck-Away Lid Holder provides handy space to hang lid· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels.· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant and 2” taller· 10-year limited warranty
